login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Three ways in, as on the reference build. This demo never contacts an auth service.
login.callbackNotice: You will continue to {path} after signing in.
login.formNotice: Demo build: nothing is submitted. Submitting sets a demo cookie so the member area can be opened.
login.otpHint: Code sent to {target} (demo: any 6 digits work)
login.demoBody: No account was checked and no request was sent. A demo session cookie was set so you can browse the member area. Use the same dialog to sign out by clearing cookies.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Email is used for verification and notices only. Every field is validated locally.
register.acceptTerms: I am 18+ and accept the terms & conditions
register.demoBody: The form validated, but no account was created and no request was sent — this build has no auth service. In the live build this step calls register, then multiLogin.
register.formNotice: Demo build: the form validates locally and stops there. No account is created.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: We email a reset link if the address is registered with us.
forgot.sent: If {email} is registered, a reset link is on its way. Demo build: no email is sent.
forgot.formNotice: Demo build: nothing is sent and no endpoint is called.

demo.notice: Demo build: submitting calls a fake endpoint and never contacts a server.
